definitions.gloss: to deny, to negate, to dismiss
definitions.explanation: To deny something that was said or claimed; to refute or contradict a statement.
When one thing cancels out or neutralizes the effect of another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広報|こうほう}→広報：05228_kouhou⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{打|う}ち{消|け}した。
examples.english: The spokesperson strongly denied the news report.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{消|け}そう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I tried to dismiss my anxious feelings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{損失|そんしつ}→損失：04875_sonshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{消|け}した。

examples.english: The sound of rain drowned out his voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{増収|ぞうしゅう}→増収：30424_zoushuu⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦コスト→コスト：06666_kosuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{消|け}して⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: The revenue increase was cancelled out by the rise in costs.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive).

COMPOUND VERB: Formed from ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to strike) + ⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ (to erase). The combination creates the meaning of 'striking something out' or 'erasing by striking.'

GRAMMAR NOTE: In grammar, ⟦{打|う}ち{消|け}し→打ち消し：21699_uchikeshi⟧ refers to negation (e.g., ⟦{打|う}ち{消|け}し→打ち消し：21699_uchikeshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{助動詞|じょどうし}→助動詞：12373_jodoushi⟧ 'negative auxiliary verb').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{消|け}す (deny a rumor)
・⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{消|け}す (deny a report)
・⟦{疑惑|ぎわく}→疑惑：13602_giwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{消|け}す (dismiss suspicions)
